scripts.test:db:ci: if [ -z "$CI" ]; then echo 'Skipping migration-backed database tests outside CI.'; exit 0; fi; mkdir -p playwright-report; { npx --yes supabase@2.106.0 init && npx --yes supabase@2.106.0 db start && npx --yes supabase@2.106.0 test db; } > playwright-report/database-ci.log 2>&1; status=$?; npx --yes supabase@2.106.0 stop --no-backup >> playwright-report/database-ci.log 2>&1 || true; cat playwright-report/database-ci.log; exit $status
scripts.verify: npm run test:run && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:db:ci
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:integration
